infobox.leads to: Forge a Friendship, or, If failed Hot Wheels:, Another Shipping Delay

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Natural Exchange is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Your friends are still taking their time, and I'm already running low on supplies because of that depot attack. I'm gonna run out of fuel if I don't do something. I found a place to get fuel, but I need your help. You know the local smugglers? They got a base near the Azure Coast. That's where you gotta drop off some gas cans. They'll fill me some fuel in return. But I think we can handle that part without you. They'll send their own people. So, you in?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Stash the first metal fuel tank at the smugglers' base on Shoreline
- Stash the second metal fuel tank at the smugglers' base on Shoreline

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +26,800 EXP
- BTR Driver Rep +0.03
- 96,000 Roubles
- 1× Graphics card
"Perfect. At least now the baby won't die in the middle of a random field. Thank you, friend!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Notes |
| Metal fuel tank | 2 | Stashed item | Any durability |
In this quest you have to stash 2 metal fuel tanks in the warehouses at the smuggler base on Shoreline.
